arguments.command:
cd /app/work && timeout 150 python3 -u -c "
import json, sys, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import adv
cases=adv.fam()
for i,(name,r) in enumerate(cases):
    data=(json.dumps(r)+chr(10)).encode()
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
        print('%-32s %-11s %.2fs' % (name, json.loads(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0])['status'], time.time()-t0))
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print('%-32s TIMEOUT >15s' % name)
    sys.stdout.flush()
" 2>&1 | tail -20
